title: Mini Shai-Hulud crosses from npm into PyPI and hits MCP server packages
summary: A worm attributed to TeamPCP compromised 172 packages across npm and PyPI in under 48 hours starting 11 May 2026, including the MCP server packages @squawk/mcp and nextmove-mcp, and its operators later published the source publicly through compromised GitHub accounts. The initial burst put 84 malicious versions of 42 TanStack packages on npm within a six-minute window.
severity_rationale: First Shai-Hulud lineage to propagate across two registries at once, with MCP server packages among the payload carriers.
